name: Arisaka Taichi
source: He has been friends with Takeru and Shiori since they were little. He is the ace of the track and field club in high school. Despite his refreshing appearance, he tends to keep his worries bottled up inside. He even has a troublesome side where he won't open up to Takeru.
translation: He has been friends with Takeru and Shiori since they were little. He is the ace of the track and field club in high school. Despite his refreshing appearance, he tends to keep his worries bottled up inside. He even has a troublesome side where he won't open up to Takeru.
